title: Systems Research Intern - Observability
location: Canada; Santa Clara, CA; United States
description: Today, NVIDIA is tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in an inclusive, encouraging environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how we can make a lasting impact on the world! NVIDIA builds data and observability systems that help engineers understand and operate large-scale services. We are looking for an intern who enjoys both asking foundational questions and building working systems to answer them. Working with observability and data platform engineers, you will study how the field may evolve over the next five years, investigate NVIDIA’s data systems, and turn promising ideas into prototypes, measurements, and clear technical recommendations. What you’ll be doing: Find, read, and critically assess research papers, technical reports, architecture documents, and industry material on observability and large-scale data systems. Track the ideas and organizations that may signal meaningful shifts in the field. Study NVIDIA’s relevant data and observability systems through documentation and conversations with engineers. Identify how today’s design choices relate to broader changes in storage, compute, query, and telemetry. Develop an evidence-based view of possible observability pathways, including which trends appear durable, which remain speculative, and what developments would change your assessment. Investigate whether object storage will become more central to observability or whether other architectures may change its role. Evaluate the question across workloads, economics, performance, and operational needs. Use AI tools to accelerate discovery, organize sources, and explore competing ideas. Verify important claims against original materials, then develop your own analysis and write original content. Write approximately two substantial whitepapers that explain your findings and propose avenues for further research or experimentation. Where possible, choose a focused prototype, benchmark, or analysis to test an important claim. What we need to see: Pursuing a MS or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or equivalent program area. Experience finding and synthesizing technical literature, evaluating competing claims, and producing clear written analysis through coursework, research, or projects. Coursework or project experience in distributed systems, databases, storage, networking, or cloud computing. Advanced programming experience and understanding of complex system implementations, to rigorously investigate technical questions. Ways to stand out from the crowd: Technical papers, substantial research reports, other writing that turns complex systems material into a clear argument. Interest in how observability, data platforms, and infrastructure may evolve as AI and large-scale computing change their workloads. Experience with OpenTelemetry (logs, metrics, tracing), object storage, data lakes, and query engines. A record of forming independent technical judgments, identifying uncertainty, and revising a position when new evidence warrants it. Experimentation in original, non-traditional, creative writing and willingness to learn quickly, ask questions, and collaborate with cross-functional teams. NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the industry working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you! Our internship hourly rates are a standard pay based on the position, your location, year in school, degree, and experience. The expected hourly rate for this position is 20 USD – 94 USD. You will also be eligible for Intern benefits . ​ Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 13, 2026. This posting is for an existing vacancy. NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes. NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Wireless Hardware Engineering Intern
location: San Jose, California, United States of America
description: Wireless Hardware Engineering Intern This role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office. Who We Are: Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE. Job Description: Job Family Definition Students or recent graduates of a college, university, or other accredited academic program who are pursuing or have recently completed a degree in a relevant technical field. Supports technical projects aligned with their area of study, including research, testing, troubleshooting, collaboration, problem-solving, and creative thinking. Gains hands-on experience while developing professional and engineering skills through an internship, research role, or other program-related opportunity. Role Summary HPE Networking is seeking a motivated student to join a cross-functional engineering team developing next-generation wireless access points. This hands-on internship provides experience in product integration, hardware bring-up, design validation, compliance testing, troubleshooting, laboratory measurements, and factory yield analysis. The intern will collaborate with engineers across RF, power, digital, systems, manufacturing, and product development disciplines while contributing to an active wireless networking project. Responsibilities Support senior engineers with assigned technical projects involving wireless access point hardware development and product integration. Assist with the bring-up, integration, and validation of wireless access points. Perform testing against design specifications, including Design Validation Testing (DVT). Support conformance and electrical compliance testing, including: Help identify, troubleshoot, and document hardware and system-level issues. Support factory yield analysis by reviewing test data, identifying trends, and helping investigate opportunities for improvement. Assist with laboratory testing using equipment such as: Spectrum analyzers, Network analyzers, Oscilloscopes, Power meters, Current-measurement equipment, Other applicable RF, power, and electronic test equipment Develop practical knowledge of wireless and networking protocols at the physical and system levels, including Wi-Fi and next-generation wireless technologies, including IEEE 802.11bn/Wi-Fi 8, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), Zigbee, Ultra-Wideband (UWB), Power over Ethernet (PoE), including IEEE 802.3, Ethernet Assist with maintaining, updating, and documenting hardware, test setups, software tools, and technical systems. Use data-analysis and AI-assisted tools, where appropriate, to analyze test results and support engineering activities. Collaborate with engineers across RF, power, digital, systems, manufacturing, and product development disciplines. Participate in team meetings, technical reviews, project discussions, and other team activities. Learn and apply engineering methodologies, laboratory procedures, and product development processes. Complete assigned tasks accurately and efficiently while meeting project deadlines. Participate in periodic reviews to provide project updates, receive feedback, and incorporate guidance into assigned work. Follow applicable safety procedures when working with electronic equipment, RF systems, power supplies, surge testing, and HIPOT testing. Education and Experience Currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical and Computer Engineering, or a related technical field. Familiarity with technical tools, laboratory equipment, programming, scripting, or data-analysis methods is preferred. Knowledge and Skills Strong interest in wireless hardware, networking, electronic systems, and product development. Basic understanding of electrical engineering principles and electronic circuits. Interest or foundational knowledge in one or more of the following areas: RF and microwave systems, Power over Ethernet, power regulation, or power conversion, Digital logic, processors, memories, and interfaces, Signal integrity and hardware validation Basic programming or scripting knowledge, such as Python, MATLAB, or a similar language. Ability to collect, analyze, and communicate technical data. Strong problem-solving, troubleshooting, and analytical skills. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. Strong attention to detail and commitment to accurate documentation. Effective time-management skills and the ability to work with project deadlines. A collaborative, solution-focused mindset and willingness to learn. Ability to work safely and follow established laboratory and engineering procedures. Accessibility HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here . Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability. Personal & Professional Development We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division. Unconditional Inclusion We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. title: Intern - Revenue Operations
description: Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all . Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. Key Responsibilities Support development and management of the 3–9 month sales plan across Business Units. Analyze forecast trends, supply constraints, and market inputs to provide forward looking revenue insights. Collaborate with Account Managers and Sales teams to align forecasts with customer commitments. Participate in forecast accuracy reviews; identify drivers of variance and improvement opportunities. Perform data analysis to identify gaps between demand signals, fulfillment expectations, and operational capabilities. Prepare executive summaries, dashboards, and presentation materials for planning reviews. Identify and document opportunities for process improvement and automation . Partner cross‑functionally to ensure alignment and visibility across revenue planning activities. Minimum Qualifications Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Supply Chain, Marketing, Business Analytics, Data Science, or related field. Must be graduating no earlier than September 2026. Strong analytical, data mining, problem-solving, and communication skills, including written, verbal, and presentation abilities. Detail oriented with the ability to manage multiple priorities and drive work to completion. Self motivated, proactive, and collaborative team approach. Ability to synthesize complex quantitative and qualitative data into actionable insights. Preferred Qualifications Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint . Experience with Power Pivot or similar tools Working knowledge of Word, Teams, and Outlook. What You’ll Gain Hands‑on experience in Revenue Operations and sales forecasting . Exposure to executive level planning and decision making. Cross functional collaboration and development of core analytical and communication skills. As a world leader in the semiconductor industry, Micron is dedicated to your personal wellbeing and professional growth. Micron also provides benefit programs that help protect your income if you are unable to work due to illness or injury, and paid family leave.
